associations.rationale: This only defines the semidirect-product presentation used for the affine group; it does not state the representation classification.
The equivalence identifies the usual affine group with the auxiliary presentation, providing the transport step rather than the classification itself.
This classifies simples for the auxiliary AffineGroup presentation, so it is the semidirect-product intermediate used to re-derive the requested classification.
The type classifies the usual affine group only for fields of cardinality greater than two; it does not itself cover the cardinality-two case needed for the complete finite-field classification.
This strengthened classification is restricted to fields of cardinality greater than two; it does not itself cover the cardinality-two case needed for the complete finite-field classification.
This handles the cardinality-two case only for the auxiliary AffineGroup presentation, making it an intermediate transport result.
The type gives only the exceptional cardinality-two classification; it does not itself cover the fields of cardinality greater than two needed for the complete finite-field classification.
This defines the multiplicative action needed to form the semidirect product but states no classification of representations.
This constructs the distinguished zero-sum representation used in the classification rather than asserting the classification.
